items.prompt: A grave, sorrowful 40-year-old Bengali mother, careworn round face, unsmiling, red bindi, small gold earrings, ivory-white cotton sari with a thin red border, its red-bordered end drawn over her head covering her hair, red blouse. Wide shot, first light, small beaten-earth courtyard: she stands on the right, holding a long straw broom low, paused mid-stroke, looking toward a closed weathered wooden door on the left. Tulsi plant, brass water pot, low whitewashed mud wall, thatch, open dawn sky. Bengal, 1880s. Pale gold, ivory, soft indigo.
